It returns no unrestricted logical state or receipt. JSON read-evidence bookkeeping is retained after existing open/publication; no new commit authority or recovery selector exists. Existing synchronous getters retain their cached semantics.

The private F2 provider obtains task, binding, event, creation receipt, preparation and cut evidence from one capture. Imported/initial checked state, Step events and History append cannot become genuine parent work.
